profile.headline: The question isn’t IF it can be done, it’s HOW we’re going to get there.
profile.summary:
The question isn't IF it can be done, but HOW we're going to get there. 


SOLUTIONS
* Designed and implemented QMS system inspired by ISO:9001 for faster audits
* Built inventory management system for use in the Pharmaceutical sector
* Developed systems reading scientificly precise data at 100hz+
* Coded industrial systems with safety-first protocols

BIG DATA
* Correlated 8 billion records across tens of tables into a millisecond query 
* Created targeted qualification algorithm reducing manual validation time to hours instead of months
* Architected data store that consumes streams from multiple scientific devices as 100hz

AUTOMATION
* 6 weeks for 4+ resources was too long, reduced deployment hours to 36 by a single technician
* 8 hours with no qualitfication is unacceptable, production go-lives are now 2 minutes with rollback

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected enterprise data warehouse leveraging hybrid SQL/NoSQL architecture for real-time analytics, enabling rapid data streaming from production devices and creating AI-ready infrastructure for predictive manufacturing insights 
• Developed intuitive C#/.NET applications for manufacturing environments with safety-critical interfaces designed for users of all skill levels, incorporating fail-safes to prevent human error in hazardous situations
• Engineered seamless integration between production systems and data warehouse, enabling end-to-end visibility across order processing, manufacturing, and delivery operations with live production metrics
• Delivered mission-critical software solutions to diverse technical stakeholders including mechanical engineers, electrical systems teams, and meteorologists for precision manufacturing operations
• Established software quality standards and led development team through implementation of DevOps processes and rigorous code reviews, creating efficient delivery pipelines from development to production
• Built high-performance data collection systems interfacing with industrial devices via RS232, RS485, voltage, and temperature sensors to capture production metrics in real-time for immediate analysis
• Optimized data solutions that support the complete device lifecycle from order through manufacturing to delivery, enhancing production efficiency and decision-making capabilities
• Implemented cloud-native data warehousing solutions that handle streaming data characteristics while maintaining scalability for rapidly expanding production environments
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-functional Team Leadership · Operating Systems · ASP.NET MVC · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Conversion · Bash · Git · Software Documentation · Powershell · Database Administration · Jira · PLC Programming · Automation Engineering · Software Industry · Docker · Cloud Computing · VBA · SQL Database Administration · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Production Deployment · C#

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
* Transformed a black-box app into an ASP.NET solution using .NET Core 3.0, incorporating JavaScript/jQuery, HTML, CSS, Dapper ORM, and T-SQL for frontend and backend operations.
* Developed the application in C# with MVC, ensuring structured, maintainable code and built SOAP & REST APIs for seamless integration.
* Designed and implemented Bitbucket CI/CD pipelines for deployment, reducing delivery time from 6 hours to 5 minutes, with a 1-minute restore for previous states.
* Managed AWS resources including Aurora MySQL, EC2 instances, and S3, ensuring optimal performance and stability.
* Automated ETL process to migrate data from MS SQL Server to AWS Aurora MySQL, speeding up transfers and improving efficiency.
* Upgraded .NET Core 3 applications to .NET Core 7, enhancing compatibility and performance.
* Created CI/CD pipelines in Bitbucket for deploying software to EC2 and loading data to AWS Aurora databases.
* Managed Bitbucket repositories, enforcing mandatory pull requests, pre-merge checks, and led code reviews to maintain high-quality standards.
* Automated Vercel deployments for Next.js projects by integrating the Vercel API, streamlining processes across QA and Production environments.
* Migrated a .NET Core app to Next.js, leveraging React 18 and Drizzle ORM to modernize and improve performance.
* Standardized development environments using Docker desktop.
* Automated full regression testing for an ASP.NET application using Selenium in .NET Core 7 and Python 3.11, reducing testing time from 7 hours to 20 minutes.
* Developed an API to interface with the MIR Robotics automated pick assistant and created a management app using Flutter/Dart for efficient customer data handling with ASP.NET APIs.
* Designed system architecture to meet customer-specific security requirements, ensuring compliance and protection.
* Actively contributed to workplace culture as a member of the Employee Engagement Committee.

positions.title: Licensing Specialist
positions.description:
* Conducted comprehensive research and meticulous analysis of Licensing Agreements, ensuring thorough comprehension and compliance.
* Leveraged data analysis techniques to identify and evaluate cost-saving opportunities, optimizing operational efficiency and financial performance.
* Crafted compelling savings proposals meticulously tailored to client needs and objectives, facilitating informed decision-making and fostering mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Engineered innovative tools and methodologies to streamline data analysis processes, significantly reducing time expenditures and enhancing productivity.

positions.title: Web Developer (Selenium)
positions.description:
* Proficient in developing Selenium WebDriver applications with AutoIt integration for efficient web data extraction.
* Designed Python scripts to effectively troubleshoot and address deficiencies within the AutoIt language, ensuring smooth application functionality.
* Demonstrated expertise in utilizing JIRA as a robust project management tool to meticulously track work progress and maintain detailed notes.
* Developed all applications using Visual Studio Code, leveraging its powerful features and intuitive interface to enhance development efficiency and code quality.
* Implemented version control practices using MedPro's custom GIT repository, ensuring seamless collaboration and comprehensive tracking of project versions.
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · AutoIt · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python · Git · JavaScript · HTML · Selenium · HTML + CSS · Process Automation

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
* Wrote ETL scripts translating flat file data from AS-400 to MS SQL Server using a temporal data model, ensuring accurate data migration.
* Developed AutoHotKey applications to streamline TSQL query generation and JSON creation for API consumption, improving workflow efficiency.
* Skilled in MS SQL Server administration, optimizing database performance and security.
* Deployed solutions to a load-balanced environment, ensuring high availability (5-Nines).
* Proficient in SharePoint administration, including workflows, configuration management, and Active Directory for user management and software deployment, reducing install time from 8 hours to 5 minutes with PowerShell automation.
* Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with detailed issue tracking in TFS and JIRA, while leading scrums to resolve project impediments.
* Audited and synchronized JIRA and TFS work items for seamless project management and submitted code updates using TFS version control.
* Translated Business Analysis Artifacts (BAAs) into user stories and functional requirements, ensuring clear documentation and creating user-friendly test cases and training materials.
* Led customer training sessions both virtually (WebEx, GoToMeeting, Skype) and in-person, ensuring comprehensive product understanding.
* Experienced in API testing with Fiddler and troubleshooting network loads using WireShark, along with implementing custom encryption for secure password storage.
* Collaborated effectively with teams across multiple geographies, spanning from India to California.

positions.title: Tax Software Analyst
positions.description:
* Proficient in ETL processes, converting county data into a format compatible with Avenu applications.
* Developed AutoHotKey applications to streamline TSQL query generation against Temporal Databases and JSON generation for API consumption.
* Extensive experience in testing APIs using Fiddler and troubleshooting application network loads using WireShark.
* Implemented custom encryption solutions for secure storage of user passwords on desktops.
* Skilled in MS SQL Server administration, ensuring optimal database performance and security.
* Proficient in SharePoint administration, including workflows and configuration management.
* Experienced in Active Directory administration, managing user accounts and access permissions.
* Successfully deployed software in load-balanced and enterprise environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance.
* Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and meticulously documented issues in TFS and JIRA.
* Audited and synchronized work items between JIRA and TFS for streamlined project management.
* Submitted code updates and enhancements through TFS version control system.
* Translated Business Analysis Artifacts (BAAs) into comprehensive user stories and functional requirements.
* Conducted customer training sessions via WebEx, GoToMeeting, Skype, and on-site visits.
* Collaborated effectively with geographically diverse teams spanning locations from India to California.

positions.title: Senior Support Analyst
positions.description:
* Automated the deployment of applications using ArcPy/Python, reducing deployment time from 6 weeks to 36 hours, and developed nightly data quality checks for NYDHS, saving manual editing time.
* Created comprehensive GIS Risk Check to ensure data accuracy and developed Triggers and Stored Procedures to automate the formatting of incoming data.
* Deployed ESRI SDE-powered Postgres databases and implemented solutions in load-balanced, geographically segmented networks ensuring high availability (5-Nines).
* Developed AutoIt and AutoHotKey applications to automate form completion, saving 3 hours of repetitive work per week.
* Tested APIs with Fiddler and troubleshooted application network loads using WireShark to ensure seamless performance.
* Coordinated the development, installation, and go-live of projects for NYDHS and deployed software to multi-site customers, maintaining mission-critical environments.
* Created network diagrams for planning software deployments and authored technical documents for training and troubleshooting.
* Recognized by the head of NYDHS GIS for exceptional project contributions.

positions.title: Software Testing Analyst
positions.description:
Spearheaded State-Wide Installation initiatives as Technical Lead, ensuring seamless deployment and operation.
    Conducted comprehensive software analysis to identify and rectify bugs, enhancing software performance and reliability.
    Innovated user experience enhancements for software applications, optimizing usability and customer satisfaction.
    Coordinated installations and updates with state-wide government agencies, ensuring smooth integration and minimal disruption.
    Provided expert support to clients, prioritizing and resolving high-impact issues promptly and effectively.
    Authored comprehensive technical support documentation, facilitating efficient troubleshooting and knowledge transfer.
    Designed and executed test cases for new software features, ensuring robust functionality and quality assurance.
    Implemented LEAN Philosophy to optimize productivity, saving 4 hours weekly through strategic hardware enhancement.
    Successfully resolved Next Generation 911 (NG911) issues, ensuring compliance and operational efficiency.
    Developed and maintained SharePoint Portals for departments and large customers, facilitating efficient collaboration and information sharing.
    Enhanced SharePoint portals to support Key Performance Indicator (KPI) tracking, enabling data-driven decision-making.
    Devised strategies to eliminate encoding time from software processes, saving 2-3 hours weekly and enhancing operational efficiency.
    Hosted informative webinars to deliver product presentations and training sessions to customers, enhancing product understanding and adoption.
    Configured and managed load-balanced servers, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of web-based applications.
